lia: FYI reproducible issue in the node sampleapp: embed-batcher + auth-refresh retry sometimes sends padding vectors with the wrong dimension to the rerank/embeddings endpoint.

samir: Can you summarize the repro and which SDK version?

lia: Node @redwood/inference v0.8.2. Repro steps: run sampleapp, trigger token refresh mid-batch (I use a short-lived token), set batching.pad_to_multiple=8. First encode returns embeddings with dim=1024. Retry attempt constructs padded vectors but they are 2048 long. Server returns 400 vector_dim_mismatch.

lia: Minimal payload I used: {items:[{id:'a',text:'x'},{id:'b',text:'y'}],batching:{max_batch_size:16,pad_to_multiple:8}} and I toggled DEBUG=redwood:batch to capture bodies.

darnell: Thanks. Likely root causes: (1) the helper keeps a module-level default that gets used when model info is missing on an error response; (2) retry path reconstructs padding from that default instead of call-scoped model.dim. Could also be a race if multiple requests share the same helper instance.

samir: Does the server ever return different response envelopes that might confuse the helper normalizer? e.g., sometimes `vectors` vs `data` with `embedding` field?

lia: Yes — when we hit the 400 the server sent an error envelope without `model` or `data`, so the helper tried to synthesize padding using DEFAULT_EMBED_DIM=2048. On success the response does include model=open-embed-1024-v1.

darnell: Proposed fix: make pad helper strictly per-call: stash original requested shapes in request-local metadata, and on retry reuse those shapes. Also avoid any writable global cache of model dim. I'll open a PR with tests that simulate an error envelope and auth refresh.

lia: Workaround for now: set pad_to_multiple=1 or downgrade to v0.7.x. I added a reproduction script to the sampleapp repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sampleapp/issues/458 with logs and curl steps.

ops-bot: Issue created: sampleapp#458 by lia - "embed-batcher: retry uses default dim on auth-refresh causing vector_dim_mismatch".

darnell: I'll take the issue. Thanks for the clear repro.

lia: Great — thanks! Leaving this thread.
